items.title: 'Spending is leading to earnings': Wall Street strategists see payoff from Big Tech's AI investment
items.summary: Wall Street sees booming cloud growth as a sign that AI spending is giving a return on investment.

items.title: SpaceX is Planning to Spend Up to $500 Billion on Data Centers. Here’s Why Elon Musk is Pushing All-In
items.summary: SpaceX is moving fast enough to potentially spend half a trillion dollars on data centers in a single year, and the inference economics driving that decision reveal something surprising about where the entire AI arms race could break down.

items.title: After Comparing Every Dividend ETF That Owns the Magnificent Seven, These 3 Pay You Without Giving Up the AI Trade
items.summary: Most dividend ETFs quietly blacklist the stocks powering the AI rally, forcing investors to choose between income and growth. Three funds built different rules, and the tradeoffs between them are not what most people expect.

items.title: At AI-Fueled Market Party, Wall Street Eyes the Rates Punch Bowl
items.summary: Enthusiasm for Big Tech and its huge investments in artificial intelligence is powering the stock market to record highs again. With a resilient economy and scorching demand, there’s seemingly only one obstacle that can derail this ride: higher interest rates.

items.title: Plug Power Tested a Backup Power System With Microsoft. Here's Why the CEO Says That's Not a Real Pivot Yet.
items.summary: Plug Power's collaboration with Microsoft to explore hydrogen fuel cell technology opens up a new market opportunity, but it doesn't represent a strategic shift for the company.

items.title: 2 Software Stocks for Long-Term Investors and 1 That Underwhelm
items.summary: Software is eating the world, and virtually no business is left untouched by it. The undeniable tailwinds fueling the industry have also led to strong returns for SaaS stocks lately as they’ve gained 48.1% over the past six months, outpacing the S&P 500’s 13.1% rise.

items.title: Open-Weight AI Won’t Crimp Demand for Picks and Shovels

items.title: Microsoft exec on Southern Europe’s big AI moment: skills — not technology — will determine who leads the region’s AI future
